  "title": "Visible handwashing flow for a new-video check",
  "reference": {
    "title": "Visible handwashing flow for a new-video check",
    "scope": "Predeclared visible-action reference for transfer checking, not a hygiene-quality assessment. Unseen actions remain unknown. No expected timestamps are supplied.",
    "steps": [
      {
        "id": "wet",
        "label": "Wet hands with water",
        "criterion": "Running or poured water visibly contacts hands before a visible soap-lather episode. A faucet or sink alone is insufficient."
      },
      {
        "id": "soap",
        "label": "Apply soap to hands",
        "criterion": "Hands visibly receive soap from a dispenser, bottle, or bar. Lather alone does not prove application."
      },
      {
        "id": "lather",
        "label": "Rub hands with soap lather",
        "criterion": "Hands rub together with visible soap foam; rubbing without visible foam is uncertain."
      },
      {
        "id": "rinse",
        "label": "Rinse hands with water",
        "criterion": "After visible lather rubbing, water visibly contacts the hands; rubbing beside a faucet is insufficient."
      },
      {
        "id": "dry",
        "label": "Dry hands",
        "criterion": "A towel or paper visibly contacts and wipes the hands, or hands are held in a visibly operating air dryer. Holding a towel nearby is insufficient."
      }
    ]
  },
  "steps": [
    {
      "step_id": "wet",

        2.0,
        4.0
      ],
      "uncertainty": "These are discrete samples; the exact start of water contact is not measured.",
      "index": 1,
      "label": "Wet hands with water"
    },
    {
      "step_id": "soap",

      "uncertainty": "Some contact is hidden by the fingers; the amount of soap is not measurable.",

    {
      "step_id": "lather",
      "status": "observed",
      "reason": "At 12 s the hands rub together away from the water stream and a thin whitish soapy patch is visible on the hand/finger surfaces. This supports rubbing with lather rather than just standing at the sink.",

        12.0
      ],
      "uncertainty": "The lather is thin and the 320-pixel sampled view is small; exact coverage or hygiene quality is not established.",
      "index": 3,

    {
      "step_id": "rinse",

        16.0,
        20.0,
        24.0

      "uncertainty": "The stream also flows in earlier frames; the cited post-lather contact, not the faucet alone, is the evidence.",
      "index": 4,
      "label": "Rinse hands with water"
    },
    {
      "step_id": "dry",
      "status": "unknown",
      "reason": "The follow-up views at 24.5, 25, and 25.5 s show hands still under or beside the running water, then the hand moves out of view at 26 s. From 26.5 through 31.936 s the images show the faucet stream and empty basin. No towel-paper wiping or visibly operating hand dryer contacts the hands in these supplied images.",

      "uncertainty": "The camera does not follow the departing hands. Drying could occur off camera; this review does not classify it as not done.",

    }
